args.notes: Plant parameters from design_report_2026.txt (current; the 2024 concept note was superseded and not used): 10 MWp DC, fixed 25° tilt, azimuth 170° (pvlib convention, south-ish), power temp coefficient -0.35%/°C (-0.0035/°C), inverter AC 8.6957 MW (8695.7 kW), DC system losses 10% (0.10). Weather table: 8760 hourly rows, UTC, irradiance in W/m2, missing-value code 9999 (applied to all hours: 240 hours with missing weather produce nothing; the remaining 8520 hours were simulated). Result from pv_yield: 13,647.8 MWh AC first-year energy; specific yield 1364.8 kWh/kWp; performance ratio 0.828 (relative to POA insolation of 1647.9 kWh/m2, which is consistent with the reported PR and specific yield).
